name: M. T. Smith
mentions: M. T. Smith and H. Gould have taken up several head of horses, branded J on left shoulder. The owner can have the same by proving property and paying charges.

…er to the Marquise de Mores for her kindness in building and donating the church to us.  Martin Timlin, M. T. Smith, John O'Sullivan, C. Gallagher, M. M. Coleman, Patrick O'Hara.  Confectionery of all kinds at Cook's.
